description: This file defines a PHP class 'DHTML_Calendar' that provides a wrapper for including and setting up a JavaScript-based calendar widget, including methods for loading necessary files, generating calendar setup code, and creating input fields with attached calendar triggers.

classes.name: DHTML_Calendar
classes.description: A PHP class that wraps around JavaScript calendar files, allowing easy inclusion and setup of a DHTML calendar widget.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the calendar object with paths, language, theme, and options.

methods.name: set_option
methods.description: Sets a specific option for the calendar.

methods.name: load_files
methods.description: Outputs HTML tags to load necessary calendar files.

methods.name: get_load_files_code
methods.description: Generates HTML code to include CSS and JavaScript files for the calendar.

methods.name: _make_calendar
methods.description: Creates JavaScript code to set up the calendar with options.

methods.name: make_input_field
methods.description: Creates an input field with an attached calendar trigger button.

methods.name: _field_id
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for input fields.

methods.name: _trigger_id
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for trigger elements.

methods.name: _make_js_hash
methods.description: Converts a PHP array into a JavaScript object notation string.

methods.name: _make_html_attr
methods.description: Converts a PHP array into HTML attribute string.
